XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for local_catquizlab — the lab store of the CAT experiment suite.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_experiment
TABLE.COMMENT: Experiment definitions: the declarative description a sweep expands into runs.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable experiment name.

FIELD.NAME: tier
FIELD.COMMENT: Tier per experimental design: baseline, main, robustness, operational.

FIELD.NAME: configjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Declarative experiment configuration (JSON): model, pool variant, stratum, strategy, budgets, replications, seeds.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=draft, 10=scheduled, 20=running, 30=finished, 40=failed.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_run
TABLE.COMMENT: One sweep cell: a concrete, seeded, reproducible run derived from an experiment.

FIELD.NAME: experimentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent experiment.

FIELD.NAME: cellkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable identifier of this sweep cell within the experiment (factor combination).

FIELD.NAME: masterseed
FIELD.COMMENT: The experiment master seed every derived seed of this run comes from.

FIELD.NAME: seed
FIELD.COMMENT: Master seed making the run reproducible.

FIELD.NAME: replication
FIELD.COMMENT: Replication index (1..R) of this cell.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=draft, 10=scheduled, 20=running, 30=finished, 40=failed.

FIELD.NAME: manifestjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Reproducibility manifest (plugin/engine versions, engine git hash, environment, seeds) — see classes/local/manifest.php.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the run's simulated users are enrolled in. Null until provisioned (E2.4).

FIELD.NAME: testcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course-module id of the adaptivequiz CAT test for this run. Null until the engine-side test is created.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_pool
TABLE.COMMENT: An item-pool variant used by a run: the ideal pool or a deterministic mutation, realised as its own set of questions and item scales (not as a CAT context — see architektur.md 2.6.A).

FIELD.NAME: experimentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning experiment.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: The run this realised pool belongs to. Null for a pool defined at experiment level.

FIELD.NAME: poolseed
FIELD.COMMENT: Seed of the ideal blueprint.

FIELD.NAME: mutationseed
FIELD.COMMENT: Seed of the mutation applied to the blueprint.

FIELD.NAME: itemcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of items actually materialised.

FIELD.NAME: variant
FIELD.COMMENT: Variant type: ideal, shifted, stretched, gappy, calibrationerror, taggingerror, depleted, combined.

FIELD.NAME: recipejson
FIELD.COMMENT: Deterministic mutation recipe (JSON): parameters and seed used to derive this variant from the ideal pool.

FIELD.NAME: scaleid
FIELD.COMMENT: Root item scale (local_catquiz catscale) of this variant. Variants differ by their items and scales, not by CAT context. Null until provisioned (E2).

FIELD.NAME: questioncategoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question-bank category holding this variant's generated question objects. Null until provisioned (E2).

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Ground truth of one materialised item: the true parameters and the true content placement, kept apart from what the CAT engine was told. Robustness conditions such as calibration and tagging errors are exactly the difference between the two.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning run.

FIELD.NAME: poolid
FIELD.COMMENT: The pool variant this item belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The generated question.

FIELD.NAME: itemname
FIELD.COMMENT: Item name from the naming engine.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Engine catmodel key the item was registered with.

FIELD.NAME: truedifficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: The true difficulty b the response oracle answers against.

FIELD.NAME: storeddifficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: The difficulty handed to the engine; differs from the true one under a calibration error.

FIELD.NAME: discrimination
FIELD.COMMENT: The true discrimination a.

FIELD.NAME: guessing
FIELD.COMMENT: The true guessing parameter c.

FIELD.NAME: stepsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Ordered step thresholds of a polytomous item (JSON), null for dichotomous items.

FIELD.NAME: truecatscaleid
FIELD.COMMENT: The engine scale the item truly belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: assignedcatscaleid
FIELD.COMMENT: The engine scale the item was registered under; differs under a tagging error.

FIELD.NAME: truecategory
FIELD.COMMENT: True category index in the blueprint.

FIELD.NAME: truesubscale
FIELD.COMMENT: True subscale index in the blueprint.

FIELD.NAME: miscalibrated
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a calibration error was injected for this item.

FIELD.NAME: mistagged
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a tagging error was injected for this item.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_person
TABLE.COMMENT: A simulated person (digital twin) of a run: ground-truth ability profile plus the Moodle user later provisioned to embody it.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning run.

FIELD.NAME: stratum
FIELD.COMMENT: Person stratum: conforming, categoryvariation, subscalevariation, chaotic.

FIELD.NAME: abilityglobal
FIELD.COMMENT: Ground-truth global ability (theta).

FIELD.NAME: profilejson
FIELD.COMMENT: Full hierarchical ground-truth profile (JSON): theta per category and subscale.

FIELD.NAME: moodleuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the simulated Moodle user embodying this person (created via the user API in E2). Plain int, not a user foreign key: the lifecycle of these throwaway test users is owned by provisioning, not by core.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_attempt
TABLE.COMMENT: One simulated CAT attempt played through the real mod_adaptivequiz UI: link to the engine attempt plus the collected trace.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning run.

FIELD.NAME: personid
FIELD.COMMENT: Simulated person who sat this attempt.

FIELD.NAME: engineattemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the adaptivequiz_attempt row in the engine (the black-box source of truth). Null until the attempt has started.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=queued, 10=running, 20=collected, 30=validated, 40=failed.

FIELD.NAME: tracejson
FIELD.COMMENT: Analysis-friendly trace copied from the engine tables/debug info: item sequence, score components, theta/SE path, activations, stop reason.

FIELD.NAME: runtimems
FIELD.COMMENT: Wall-clock runtime of the attempt in milliseconds, reported by the worker.

FIELD.NAME: tries
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of times the attempt has been claimed/tried (for retry limiting).

FIELD.NAME: nextruntime
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest time the attempt may be (re)claimed; used for staggering and retry backoff.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_result
TABLE.COMMENT: A computed evaluation metric value at a given aggregation scope (run, stratum, tier).

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Run the metric was computed for.

FIELD.NAME: metric
FIELD.COMMENT: Metric key: rmse, correlation, bias, spearman, precisionatk, recall, ndcgatk, testlength, etc.

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Aggregation scope: run, stratum:name, tier:name.

FIELD.NAME: value
FIELD.COMMENT: Scalar metric value.

FIELD.NAME: detailjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional structured detail (e.g. confusion matrix, per-k values).

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_exportlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Record of a produced export (xlsx, ods, csv, xml, json) for a run or experiment.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Run exported (null when the export spans a whole experiment).

FIELD.NAME: experimentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Experiment exported (set for experiment-level exports).

FIELD.NAME: format
FIELD.COMMENT: Export format: xlsx, ods, csv, xml, json.

FIELD.NAME: dataset
FIELD.COMMENT: Dataset level: rawmatrix, traces, groundtruth, results, aggregation, manifest.

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: File API item id of the stored export file, when persisted.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_transfer
TABLE.COMMENT: Log of run-package transfers between a node and the central hub (submit/fetch), with integrity hash and status.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Local run involved in the transfer (null on the hub side before mapping).

FIELD.NAME: direction
FIELD.COMMENT: submit (node to hub) or fetch (hub to node).

FIELD.NAME: remotehost
FIELD.COMMENT: Counterpart host URL.

FIELD.NAME: payloadhash
FIELD.COMMENT: Integrity hash of the run package (SHA-256).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=pending, 10=sent, 20=acknowledged, 40=failed.

TABLE.NAME: local_catquizlab_scalemap
TABLE.COMMENT: Maps a run's materialised engine CAT scales to the ground-truth profile structure (level, category and subscale indices), so the response oracle can resolve the subscale ability for a presented item.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: The run this mapping belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: catscaleid
FIELD.COMMENT: The engine catscale id (local_catquiz_catscales).

FIELD.NAME: parentcatscaleid
FIELD.COMMENT: The engine parent catscale id (0 for the root).

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: The engine CAT context id.

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=root/global, 1=category, 2=subscale.

FIELD.NAME: categoryindex
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based category index in the profile (null for the root).

FIELD.NAME: subscaleindex
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based subscale index in the profile (null unless level 2).

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The scale name.
